gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-hk: Noto Sans HK sets large lowercase forms with tight ascender clearance, a sturdy sans for running text. Nulshock stretches out above it in spacious, unshaded outlines, so paragraphs below would read steadily and without fuss.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-imperia: Technical and bold, Nulshock stretches its outlines wide. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic follows with a c whose ends point apart like open pincers, so extended reading keeps moving without snagging.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Bent tubing in letter form, wide, bold and the same gauge throughout. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, with big open eyes on its e and a, keeps long reading comfortable under Nulshock.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-kayah-l: Lifted brush ends keep the lowercase here open and quick to follow, while Nulshock stretches out in marker-tip letters. Noto Sans Kayah Li, a sans-serif with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, carries extended text without tiring.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: Nulshock stretches wide and technical, every stroke held to the same gauge. Noto Sans Kharoshthi, with curves that never close and a dark stripe of lowercase, makes long reading feel approachable.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Spacious, stretched lettering at a single thickness is what defines Nulshock at first glance. And Noto Sans Khmer, with generous openings and near-capital lowercase, gives those wide headings a sturdy partner underneath.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Hollow, glass-tube lettering stretched wide gives Nulshock its technical edge. Noto Sans Khojki sits beneath with wide exits and a large eye on every e, letting light through.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-khudawa: Rounds left unlatched and capitals just above the lowercase make the text approachable, in contrast to Nulshock's wide, followable outline. Noto Sans Khudawadi holds up at modest sizes, so the large sizes can go to the heading.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-lao: Modern through and through, Noto Sans Lao sits under Nulshock's bent-tube lettering. Its x-height runs well above the usual and its mouths stay open, so extended reading goes down easily.
gen-dafont-nulshock-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Wide-set and pen-drawn, Nulshock holds one constant line width from end to end. And where Nulshock is made to announce, Noto Sans Lisu is made to carry text, its s curves open wide.
